_comment: steer_text (linear regime + block_ridge) from google-t5/t5-base to google-t5/t5-large, encoder-only classification, with the TARGET head built by linear probing BEFORE the rebasin method runs (linear_probe_stage='pre'). Base config for scripts/sbatch_text_rebase_t5enc_nli6_linearprobe_pre_sweep.sh, which overrides tasks/seed/method_params per array element.
_no_head_file: No target_task_heads here on purpose: linear_probe_head builds B's head in-run and the two are mutually exclusive. This replaces the scripts/build_nearest_mean_head.py step the nearest-mean sbatch scripts run first -- linear_probe_init='nearest_mean' still seeds the probe from the same centroids, it just does it in-process on the pristine base.
_stage_pre: With stage='pre' the order is probe -> inject -> prepare/transport -> eval, so steer_text's Stage 1 reads a trained w_b off the live head instead of B's from-scratch random init. alpha=1.0 is therefore meaningful here, unlike the alpha=0 probe baseline.
_source_ckpts: Local transformers directories written by scripts/convert_t5_encoder_ckpt.py (t5base_6text_noreg_ntk). _load_tuned_source_state_dict treats a local dir exactly like a Hub id, so source_model_name_or_path must be the pretrained base they were fine-tuned from: google-t5/t5-base (original T5, vocab 32128 -- matches google-t5/t5-large on the target side).
